criteria.AC1: Both binding test files pass within the broader regression, including strict/report loss, unknown metadata, context and provenance conflicts and both recovery directions
criteria.AC2: Native discovery and classification preserve required/optional parent/member distinctions, masked-buffer behavior and exact bytes with independently rechecked decoded values
criteria.AC3: Generated schema files pass native reads and present/null/omitted row writes; float narrowing remains an explicit counterexample
criteria.AC4: Both Chromium matrices pass with parity, serialized recovery and forged-receipt refusals without host globals or external requests
criteria.AC5: Typecheck, 230 schema audits, 37 package audits and browser build pass
criteria.AC6: All 62 refresh commands pass including broader priority regression; separate Field gate passes after actual five-system native/browser rerun
criteria.AC7: Current source fingerprints and tested profiles are recorded; separate ideal delivery and native-equivalence gates remain explicit

regression.scope: All tests/core, tests/core-ideals, tests/postgresql, tests/sqlserver, tests/tablespec, tests/avro and tests/parquet test files except field-conformance.test.ts, run separately after evidence refresh.

limits: Classification requires core 0.3.0 Field kind, checked physical leaf/container topology and explicit definition-level carrier.
Row scope includes optional ancestors and refuses repeated paths; repeated-entry scope assumes the innermost entry exists and includes only subsequent optional nodes.
Writer masks, logical annotations, Arrow metadata and scalar cardinality are separate meanings; physical availability does not validate arbitrary inputs or pages.
Native writer coercions from masked containers remain counterexamples, not portable defaults. Metadata absent from original bytes cannot be reconstructed.
Original captured pages and unknown/embedded metadata stay byte-exact; no native-equivalence graduation.
Authored projection emits an empty file with one non-repeated physical leaf and one explicit carrier, not application row data. Native row writes are test evidence.
Unspecified emits OPTIONAL with no-authored-requirement provenance; report losses retain original obligations. Native-only classification cannot reconstruct authorship.
Cardinality, facets, descriptions, defaults and other unclaimed metadata require residuals or strict refusal. Binary32 narrowing prevents general float exactness claims.
Receipts verify reproducibility and unchanged artifacts, not authenticity.
All five priority bindings now have qualified evidence; experimental Nullability admission/delivery still requires its separate gate.
